name: SKhV-VNKhK (Eastern Petrochemical Complex) Gas Branch Pipelines
monitor_reason: length (no sourced length for any VNKhK-specific line; 2019-only source) and concrete step/window (Rosneft halted VNKhK in 2019; no construction evidence)
researcher_notes: Only evidence: neftegaz.ru 2019 (Gazprom building 2 gas pipelines + 3 GRS for VNKhK; no lengths, no route, no sponsor agreement on gas supply; Gazprom said Rosneft must supply its own gas). Rosneft reportedly stopped/removed VNKhK from investment plans in 2019 (Kommersant/Forbes snippets); 2025 reports only of government studying revival. Searched for lengths/status in Russian: none found. Not matched to an existing GEM row (no Nakhodka/Vrangel row in roster). Distinct, separate lines found but NOT VNKhK-attributed: Gazprom Vrangel GRS branch from SKhV at Bolshoy Kamen (~94-98 km per search snippets, article says 168 km incl. Nakhodka; purpose Zvezda shipyard/gasification, 2019 start planned) and a ~3.5 km, 600 mm spur from GRS Vrangel to the Nakhodka fertilizer plant (u3; VNKhK not mentioned). The Vrangel branch may be worth its own vetting as a separate candidate (conflicting lengths 94/98/168 km need a primary source) - not done here. Refs are context only, none supports a row value.
